nEva: naiva bhavati na na bhavatitathāgataḥ paraṃ maraṇāt(maraṇataḥ)
nEvasa: sa sarvaśa ākiṃcanyāyatanaṃ samatikramya naivasaṃjñānāsaṃjñāyatanam upasampadya viharaty ayaṃ saptamo vimokṣaḥ
sa sarvaśo ākiṃcanyāyatanaṃ samatikramya naivasaṃjñānāsaṃjñāyatanam upasampadya viharati
nEratmya: nairātmyāḥ sarva dharmāḥ sattvāś ca nairātmyaṃ nādhimucyante. atas tathāgatasya sattveṣu mahākaruṇotpadyate
